summary: Visual density tightening of Revenue 'Daily History' verified on 420x900 mobile viewport. All 7 seeded date rows render, each row is exactly 42px tall (well under the <=46px threshold; previously 51px — a visible ~18% slimmer row). Content remains fully legible (day tile, weekday+month+day+year label, 'Today' badge, sells+coins subline, profit value, chevron). Hero card, chart, and drill-down navigation continue to work. Symbol regression (BTCUSDT) intact.

issues: Revenue.jsx root uses only `pb-4` (16px), while the fixed bottom nav bar (`data-testid=nav-trade`) is ~76-90px tall. On 420x900, the last two date rows (06-30 and 06-29 in this seed) sit at y=836 and y=858; their centers fall behind the fixed nav bar unless the user scrolls the entire list. Consider `pb-24` (or a spacer div matching nav height) so the last rows remain fully tappable without extra scrolling. Reproduced deterministically via Playwright: clicking the geometric center of revenue-date-2026-06-29 lands on nav-trade instead. Tapping the top portion (or after scrolling to bottom) works correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Increase bottom padding on Revenue.jsx root (pb-4 -> pb-24) to keep the last Daily History rows above the fixed bottom navigation on tall lists. Same likely applies to any other page with a scrollable list ending near the viewport bottom.
critical_code_review_comments: Revenue.jsx L124: `dt.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'short', timeZone:'UTC'})` now correctly passes timeZone UTC for the tile month — matches previous review comment fix. Good.
Revenue.jsx L133 uses `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` for todayStr. Correct UTC comparison. OK.
Revenue.jsx root `pb-4` should be `pb-24` to clear the fixed BottomNav on mobile — see design_issues.
The row `active:scale-[0.99]` transition may cause the click point to move slightly at press-time; not a blocker but consider removing it for tighter tap targets on already-slim (42px) rows.
Icons/svg lucide (ChevronRight) at size 12 with color #8B9BB4 has good contrast; passes.

Note the fixed bottom-nav overlap: when writing Playwright clicks against rows near list bottom, either (a) scroll to page bottom first, or (b) click near the top-left of the row (offset y=+10) instead of center, or (c) use JS .click() via ElementHandle. rca of the issue: No blocking bug found. The initially-observed 'loss day click doesn't apply date filter' turned out to be a Playwright artifact: after scroll_into_view_if_needed the row's bounding-box center for revenue-date-2026-06-29 (y=858) was underneath the fixed bottom-nav (nav-trade) so force-click hit the nav instead. Verified by (i) direct URL /transactions?date=2026-06-29 → correct 1 SELL SOL -$6.42 and chip 'MON, JUN 29, 2026', (ii) scrolling to page bottom then clicking top of the row → correct navigation and chip. Underlying UX consideration: Revenue.jsx wrapper only has pb-4 which is insufficient bottom padding relative to the fixed nav height — recommended fix pb-24.
